title: Hang a 24-inch TV on its tilt wall mount: pull it off the wall to clear the rail, then drop both hidden hooks on at once
instruction: Hang the TV on its wall mount.
context: Hanging a flat-screen TV on its wall mount is a common household job, and the mount's maker draws it as a two-person lift. The hooks are hidden behind the panel: the 3.3 kg TV must be pulled off the wall until its hooks clear the rail, lifted, held level, brought in and lowered so both catch together. Lifted straight up, the hooks jam under the rail; held crooked, one hook catches and the TV hangs askew; let go early, it falls.
setup: Table top 74.75 cm high; x forward from the arm bases, y left. TV (LG 24LQ520S-PU, full size and real mass): black plastic, 56.4 wide x 34.0 high x 5.84 cm deep (2.0 cm panel rim all round, 40 x 25 x 3.84 cm rear housing), 3.27 kg; two steel brackets (2.5 cm wide, 2 cm deep, 23.6 cm long) bolted 7.5 cm apart on its VESA 75 holes (centre 18 cm above its bottom edge), each with a top hook (3 mm tab, 4 x 10 mm down-turned finger) and a 1.6 cm foot at its lower end. It starts standing on its bottom edge on the table, screen to the arms, screen face at x 34.4 cm, centre at y +2.5 cm, leaning back about 1.5 degrees with its hooks against the plate below the top rail. Wall section: painted board 100 x 56 x 2 cm (22 cm past the TV on each side), face at x 45 cm, standing on the table, centred at y 0; pencil mark (3 cm vertical line, 2 cm tick) at y 0, 38 cm above the table. Wall plate (Monoprice 5915, full size): 2 mm steel, 44.45 x 21.6 cm, centre 20 cm above the table at y 0; its top and bottom edges turn out 2 cm and up 1.4 cm into rails with 1.2 cm deep channels. Distractors, loose SimReady props, ignored by scoring: PH2 screwdriver 18.8 x 3.4 x 3.2 cm, 0.10 kg, at (20, 12) cm, yaw 25 degrees; candle 7.4 cm across, 7.5 cm tall, 0.35 kg, at (24, -11) cm; notebook 22.9 x 17 x 1 cm, 0.12 kg, at (12, -1) cm, yaw -10 degrees.
scoring: 1.0: both bracket hooks seated on the top rail (each hook's finger bottom inside the rail's channel, 6.5-12.5 mm below the lip top), both brackets' lower ends against the bottom rail (each foot's wall-side face within 3 mm in front of the rail lip's front face, or up to 1 mm into it, with its centre at the lip's height, 2 mm in from its top and bottom), the TV's centre within 15 mm sideways of the pencil mark, roll and tilt each within 2 degrees, every fingertip at least 4 cm from the TV, and the TV moving under 1 cm/s and 0.05 rad/s, all continuously for 1 s. 0.5: both hooks seated and hands 4 cm clear, but not all of the above. 0.25: one hook seated and hands 4 cm clear. 0: no hook seated, a fingertip within 4 cm of the TV, or the TV at any time moved down faster than 0.5 m/s or tipped more than 30 degrees from upright.
reset_notes: Lift the TV 2 cm off the rail, pull it 3 cm off the wall, lower it to the table and lean it back under the plate, its centre 25 mm left of the pencil mark. Nothing is consumed.
fidelity: TV (LG 24LQ520S-PU) and mount (Monoprice 5915) at full size; the TV at its real 3.27 kg. The wall is a 100 x 56 cm board on the table, 22 cm wider than the TV on each side: plate 20 cm up, hung TV 2 cm above the console. TV is rigid boxes; housing, VESA height, bracket and rail profiles approximated from the manual's drawings. No lower lock screw. Uniform friction, no force sensing. Distractors are SimReady props.
